basics.name: Carmina Nascimento
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing scalable backend systems, modernizing legacy applications, and delivering enterprise software from concept to production. Experienced in Kotlin, Java, Python, Spring Boot, .NET, Google Cloud Platform, and Angular, with a strong focus on software architecture, developer productivity, technical leadership, and AI-assisted engineering. Focused on building maintainable systems, mentoring engineers, and improving software delivery through automation and engineering best practices.

work.name: Instituto de Pesquisas Eldorado
highlights: Design, develop, and maintain 4 cloud-native backend services using Kotlin, Java, Spring Boot, Python (Flask), MySQL, and Google Cloud Platform, supporting enterprise-scale applications.
Develop RESTful APIs and event-driven integrations using Google Cloud Pub/Sub and asynchronous messaging, enabling scalable communication between distributed systems.
Collaborate on architectural decisions across monolithic and distributed services, improving scalability, maintainability, and long-term system evolution.
Apply Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles when evolving backend services and domain boundaries, supporting clearer separation of responsibilities and maintainable system evolution.
Optimized complex database queries and backend processing, reducing page loading time from 1 minute 40 seconds to 17 seconds (an 83% improvement) and significantly enhancing the user experience.

Led the technical implementation of a new Net Promoter Score (NPS) feature, designing approximately 12 user interfaces, implementing backend and frontend components, designing the database schema, documenting the architecture, and coordinating data integration with consuming teams from design through production.

Championed a documentation-first engineering culture by authoring 20+ technical documents in Confluence, including onboarding guides, architecture documentation, Engineering Decision Records (EDRs), database schemas and development workflows, creating a sustainable engineering knowledge base.
Mentor trainees and interns, contributing to the conversion of two interns into full-time engineers.
Leveraged AI-assisted design tools (Gemini CLI and Stitch) to rapidly prototype UI/UX concepts, enabling efficient collaboration with Product Management in the absence of a dedicated designer.

Designed and developed LLM-powered developer productivity tools adopted across the engineering team, including an assistant that analyzes Jira change requests together with the project codebase to explain requirements, identify impacted components, and reduce dependency on senior engineers during implementation.

Developed an AI-assisted workflow adopted across the team that generates and updates unit tests based on source code changes, significantly reducing the manual effort required to create test scaffolding while preserving developer review and quality standards.

Served as a primary technical contact for platform users, gathering feedback, translating user needs into technical requirements, and partnering with Product Management to prioritize improvements that enhanced product usability and customer satisfaction.
Co-authored peer-reviewed technical publications based on engineering projects, transforming practical software engineering experience into published research.

work.name: Sidia Instituto de Ciência e Tecnologia
highlights: Designed, developed, and maintained enterprise software solutions using Java, C#, .NET, WPF, JavaScript, Angular, MySQL, and REST APIs, supporting Samsung's Quality Assurance organization across multiple strategic initiatives.

Assumed technical leadership of a critical project following the departure of the technical lead, planning delivery, coordinating 2 software engineering interns, leading technical discussions, collaborating with Samsung stakeholders, and successfully delivering the remaining project scope.

Designed and developed a centralized quality management platform that replaced spreadsheet-based workflows for Samsung's Latin America QA hub, enabling approximately 25 QA engineers to manage 80+ concurrent testing projects, execution status, and validation results through a web application that remains in active use.
Designed scalable backend services and REST APIs supporting enterprise quality assurance workflows and cross-system integrations.
Led the modernization of legacy backend services by migrating APIs to .NET 5, improving maintainability, reliability, and long-term platform evolution.

Modernized a large legacy analytics platform by refactoring backend services, migrating business logic from the frontend to the backend, and improving application architecture while continuing to deliver new features.

Optimized backend services and database operations powering near real-time dashboards, charts, maps, and reporting for Samsung device quality monitoring, processing data from thousands of devices daily while improving application responsiveness and scalability.
Redesigned application workflows in collaboration with UX designers, delivering more intuitive interfaces and improving usability across multiple system modules.
Established automated quality gates by implementing GitLab CI pipelines that enforced unit test coverage thresholds, preventing quality regressions during continuous integration.
Developed comprehensive unit tests and extended an internal Visual Studio add-in to provide developers with real-time code coverage feedback, improving software quality and developer productivity.

Participated in architecture discussions, conducted code reviews, and led large-scale refactoring initiatives that reduced technical debt, simplified future development, and improved long-term maintainability.
